image_description: The image displays two traffic light units suspended against a cloudy sky and a modern building facade. The primary subject is a vertical traffic light on the left, showing an illuminated red signal at the top. It has a black housing with visors over three circular lenses. A second, unlit traffic light hangs to the right, angled away from the viewer. Overhead wires and mounting hardware are visible.
